text: Implemented SparseFunctionalFactorization: certified Euclidean/generalized/smoothed factor geometries; degree-one L1, sparse-group, and TV bundles on either side; epsilon-certified convex GPMF block solves; explicit normalization, sign gauge, zero solution, stopping, ordering, orthogonality, and achieved guarantee records; greedy rank-k deflation; separate exact generalized cross-SVD joint rank-k fit and typed nonsmooth rejection. Added ordinary PCA, GMD/GPCA, sparse PCA, functional PCA, two-way sparse-smooth, planted recovery, TV, zero, deflation-vs-joint, and homogeneity oracles. Verification: focused 11/11 JVM and 11/11 JS; full multivar 392/392 on both before final sparse-limit addition; full linalg 52/52 on both; git diff --check and mote doctor clean.
